claim: A service owner onboards a service to PrivateLink by putting a Network Load Balancer in front of it and creating a PrivateLink service registered with that load balancer; customers can create endpoints in their VPC after the owner allow-lists their accounts and IAM roles.

values.display: a Network Load Balancer to front your service
values.spoken: a Network Load Balancer in front of the service

values.display: allow-list their accounts and IAM roles
values.spoken: allow-list the consumer accounts and roles

evidence.quote: As a service owner, you can onboard your service to AWS PrivateLink by establishing a Network Load Balancer to front your service and create a PrivateLink service to register with the Network Load Balancer. claim: A resource owner onboards a resource to PrivateLink by creating a resource configuration in Amazon VPC Lattice; customers can create endpoints in their VPC after the owner shares the resource configuration with their accounts using AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM).
